TEAM TRAMPOLIN
A student technology team from Prague. We experiment, build, and learn by making technology and creative projects.

Hugo Kubíček / Team lead
Daniel Voženílek / Team member
Vojtěch Čakrt / Team member
Honza Smrz / Team member

Hugo, Daniel, and Vojtěch worked together on DemocraTICon. The other portfolio projects were built by Hugo Kubíček; each detail credits its author.

EVOHACKS 2026 / ClearMessage / 2nd place
DemocraTICon / National final / 3rd place

ClearMessage
A research prototype for understanding suspicious messages. The public demo replays a recorded result.
https://tymtrampolin.cz/projects/clearmessage/

Real estate video
Six AI videos for three property projects for a RE/MAX agent: future buildings, renovations, and life at home.
https://tymtrampolin.cz/projects/real-estate-video/

Website studies
SkyRing, TitanGOAT, and Olomouc. Studies in design, development, interaction, and visual storytelling.
https://tymtrampolin.cz/projects/website-studies/

DOOM Bounce
A playable browser experiment with custom raycasting, bosses, and AI-generated animation and voices.
https://tymtrampolin.cz/projects/doom-bounce/

Education tools
Academic Vanguard for choosing seminars and an information site for the Berlin 2026 school trip.
https://tymtrampolin.cz/projects/education-tools/

AI radio
An autonomous music generation MVP. Broadcasting is paused; the next version and research are in progress.
https://tymtrampolin.cz/projects/ai-radio/
